title: Pip and the Trail
checkpoint: Reception Summer 2, week 4 — Phase 4: Longer and compound words: longer words and compound words (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 complete, 76-sound stage (nd, nt, nk, ft, lt, lf just added).

pages.text: Pip spots a bit on the path.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow noticing a small crumb lying on the garden path.

pages.text: Pip spots a bit next to it.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow spotting a second small crumb a little further along.

pages.text: Pip gets a bit. Then Pip gets a bit.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping along, picking up crumbs one after another.
Pip the sparrow looking along a trail of small crumbs stretching into the distance.
Pip the sparrow following the trail of crumbs further along the path.

pages.text: The trail is next to a box.
pages.illustration: The trail of crumbs leading right up to a small wooden box.

pages.text: Pip gets up on the box.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow hopping up onto the lid of the wooden box.

pages.text: Nell is on the box! Nell left the trail.
pages.illustration: Nell the bee sitting on top of the box, an empty crumb bag beside her.

pages.text: Pip and Nell grin. What fun!
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow and Nell the bee grinning together on top of the box.
